newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: European feeds see light nearby trade.
newsitem.headline: European feeds see light nearby trade.

text.p: The European meals and feeds market saw light trade in Argentine soymeal and sunmeal pellets on nearby positions this afternoon, market sources said.

"Despite weaker seller prices the market was dull apart from light hand-to-mouth buying in Argentine soy and sunmeal. Even an easier dollar failed to spark activity as calls for an easier Chicago soymeal futures opening kept many buyers sidelined," one broker said.

Afloat Argentine soymeal pellets traded at $259 a tonne cif and $263 fob Rotterdam and Oct at $258.50 cif. Oct Argentine sunmeal pellets fetched $148 a tonne cif Rotterdam.--KAREL LUIMES +31 20 504 5832
